notes.title: Testers Wanted: Superbot Arena VR!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3266864/8697ecca534d19018ae65935e12feae977851ac8.png[/img]

Want to make a custom superbot and fight others in a VR battle arena? Punch, shoot, sneak, blast and more with custom gestures, abilities and effects in this upcoming multiplayer AND single player game.

[b]I need your help to test it! Free keys will be given in return for feedback.[/b] I reserve the right to disable the key if no useful feedback is provided after a reasonable amount of time.

Inspired by "Super Smash Bros: Melee", "RUMBLE" and "Dragon Fist: Kung Fu VR", supporting different game modes, items, co-op and all sorts of chaos.

If you are interested, let me know in the comments and I'll pick some and be in touch! Thank you!

--> [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/phr00t/announcements]Easy Link for Comments & Showing Interest[/url][/b] <--

- Phr00t
